name: Payments
vision: Collect a payment from a client through whichever processor is handling it, and hold a clean record of what was attempted and what the processor said happened.

aggregates.name: Payment
aggregates.description: One attempt to collect money from a client through a specific payment processor.

invariants.description: a currency is a three-letter code
a currency is a three-letter code

commands.name: Initiate
commands.goal: Start an attempt to collect a payment from a client through a processor

commands.name: Succeed
commands.goal: Record that the processor confirmed the payment

givens.description: only a pending payment can succeed
the processor matches the one this payment was initiated with

commands.name: Fail
commands.goal: Record that the processor declined the payment

givens.description: only a pending payment can fail
the processor matches the one this payment was initiated with

commands.name: Refund
commands.goal: Ask the processor to give the customer some or all of their money back

givens.description: only a succeeded payment can be refunded
a refund cannot exceed what is left to refund
the refund currency matches the payment's own

commands.name: CompleteRefund
commands.goal: Record that the processor gave back the last of what was owed

givens.description: only a refund in progress can complete
the processor matches the one this payment was initiated with
the confirmed amount matches what was actually requested
this refund finishes the payoff

commands.name: RecordPartialRefund
commands.goal: Record that the processor gave back part of what was owed, more still to come

givens.description: only a refund in progress can be recorded
the processor matches the one this payment was initiated with
the confirmed amount matches what was actually requested
this refund does not yet finish the payoff

commands.name: DeclineRefund
commands.goal: Record that the processor could not give the money back

givens.description: only a refund in progress can be declined
the processor matches the one this payment was initiated with

commands.name: OpenDispute
commands.goal: Record that a customer disputed this payment with their bank

givens.description: only a succeeded payment can be disputed
the processor matches the one this payment was initiated with

commands.name: WinDispute
commands.goal: Record that the dispute was resolved in the merchant's favor

givens.description: only a disputed payment can be resolved
the processor matches the one this payment was initiated with

commands.name: Chargeback
commands.goal: Record that the disputed funds were forcibly taken back

givens.description: only a disputed payment can be charged back
the processor matches the one this payment was initiated with

queries.name: Status
queries.description: What happened to a specific payment, by its own reference.

queries.name: Pending
queries.description: Every payment still waiting on a processor to report in.

queries.name: Succeeded
queries.description: Every payment a processor has confirmed.

queries.name: Failed
queries.description: Every payment a processor has declined.
